modules.title: Complex Number Foundations
modules.summary: Start from algebraic form, geometric interpretation, and the complex plane as the base language of the course.

modules.title: Limits and Continuity in the Complex Plane
modules.summary: Reconnect sequence, limit, and continuity ideas from analysis and move them into complex-valued settings.

modules.title: Complex Differentiation and Analytic Functions
modules.summary: Build the meaning of complex derivatives and analytic behavior through comparison with real-variable ideas.

modules.title: Complex Integration
modules.summary: Study contour-style integration and connect it to earlier work on integrals and paths.

modules.title: Taylor, Laurent, and Applications
modules.summary: Use expansions and local representations to reason about complex functions and integral applications.

clos.label: Explain the algebraic and geometric foundations of complex numbers.
Analyze limits and continuity of complex functions using prior analysis knowledge.
Explain and apply complex differentiation, analytic functions, and holomorphic functions.
Explain and compute complex integrals along suitable paths.
Use Taylor and Laurent series to study complex functions and support integral reasoning.
